title: Amphitheater Pool

services.name: Pools and Splash Pads
services.desc: Amphitheater Pool is a competitive, Olympic-size pool with 16 lanes, a 50-meter pool featuring 25-yard courses at each end, a diving bay with 1- and 3-meter boards in the middle, and shade structures. services.name: Teen Programs
services.desc: A Discount Program is available for all In-Betweeners and Junior Staff in Training programs for those who need low-income assistance. You must qualify for the discount program prior to registration to receive a discount. The focus of Junior Staff in Training is to provide teens, 14-17 years of age, with an experience aimed at improving leadership skills, building self-esteem, and preparing them for future employment, specifically in the field of recreation. Teens will learn planning, group management, critical thinking skills, how to properly communicate, teamwork, and basic job application and interviewing skills.
